question: Which artist has released the most albums?
sql:
SELECT
    Artist.Name,
    COUNT(*) AS AlbumCount
FROM
    Album
JOIN
    Artist ON Album.ArtistId = Artist.ArtistId
GROUP BY
    Artist.ArtistId,
    Artist.Name
ORDER BY
    AlbumCount DESC
LIMIT 1;
